name: Chadd "F'n" Matthews
notes: Known from one roleplay posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy on 19 February 2000, served at /promotions/nawa-fallout-2000/archive/chadd-matthews-2000-02-19.html: the NAWA Television Champion, alone in an empty arena in a white long-sleeved shirt with purple flames and his name in lime-green letters, the title hung over the seat in front of him. He tells the booing fans he will add the NAWA World Title in the tournament, calls out Mark Marino, the only man with a win over him, for Tuesday's semi-final, and dismisses T-Money as a bug easy to kill. His sign-off gives his NAWA record as 3-1 and the Television title.
caption: The NAWA Television Champion who calls out Mark Marino and T-Money before the World Title tournament semi-finals in February 2000.

identity.note: Recorded distinct, pending a verdict: the SSCW's Chadd Mathews (April to May 2000, spelled with one t) shares the first name's unusual double d, and the NCWA's own page of 27 April 2000 serves a Chadd Mathews too, but no card, roster or text joins either to this NAWA champion of February 2000. A name alone is not presumed.
